caption: The image depicts a piece of fabric, likely a sampler or wall hanging, with embroidery. The main fabric appears to be a light beige or off-white cloth. It is bordered by a red and blue cross-stitched pattern. Across the top section, the text "SAMUEL WEAVER" is stitched in alternating colors of red, blue, gold, and green, and is flanked by cross motifs. Below this text are three main embroidered motifs: the left and right motifs depict stylized floral arrangements with multicolored flowers in a pot, and the center motif shows a symmetrical design of four red birds perched on a tree or branches with additional colorful shapes. Underneath the bird motif, the numbers "1838" are stitched, probably indicating a year. Below, another section of text in alternating colors reads, "WHEN THIS YOU SEE REMEMBER ME MARIA WEYER," with the same cross motifs separating words. The lower part of the fabric has three horizontal rows of red and blue cross-stitching and three strips of fringe. The entire piece uses chiefly red, blue, gold, and green thread for the cross-stitches and motifs, maintaining a consistent color scheme throughout.
title: Pennsylvania German Show Towel
